name: Playboys, Ventures, Pulaski Park, Rice Boys
description: The Playboys, Ventures, Pulaski Park, and Rice Boys were an alliance of white Polish-American Stone Greaser gangs in Chicago's West Town and Austin neighborhoods, active from the late 1950s through the mid-1980s. The three core groups — Playboys, Ventures, and Pulaski Park Boys — united as the PVP (Playboys-Ventures-Pulaski Park) alliance. A separate PVR alliance included the Rice Boys. The groups were rivals of the Gaylords but briefly allied with them in the 1970s, and rivals of the Ashland Vikings. The alliance disbanded by the mid-1980s.
